proposal: The Mandate says the Office for Civil Rights published in 2016 a list of colleges that had applied for a religious exemption from Title IX, which it calls a list of shame and notes is still publicly available in an archive on the Department's website. It recommends an executive order removing the archived list and preventing such a list from being published in the future (p. 357).
remaining: Remove the archived 2016 list from the Department's website (p. 357)
Executive order or equivalent bar on publishing such a list in future (p. 357)
